name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index 92 and US 10-year yield near 4.98% on 10 Nov; readings under Watch lines but the measured floor keeps Watch
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility was near 92 on 10 Nov, 1.5% lower on the week, and the US 10-year yield closed near 4.98%, about 23bp lower than a month earlier (Yahoo Finance). Yields rose during the session after October consumer prices came in above forecasts. Both readings sit under the Watch lines (MOVE 100, 40bp a month), but the measured floor keeps Watch until they clear them more decisively.
for_you: US borrowing costs remain near their highest in years, which feeds through to mortgage and loan rates worldwide.
rubric_hit: MOVE 92.4 has not yet cleared the 90 exit line, so Watch holds

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofA MOVE Index

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
